data.narrative:
Dream Security, a Series B defense and security company founded by Shalev Hulio, Sebastian Kurz, and Gil Dolev, has raised $100M+ and carries a current post-money valuation of $3.0B. The comparable universe consists of 10 peer companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—all operating in the Defense & Security sector at similar stages.

Two valuation methods were applied to triangulate fair value. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $3.0B base, implying $5.7B. Peer-median analysis draws from six same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $300M to $1.4B (Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, Defense Unicorns, Heven AeroTech, and one additional peer). The median across this set is $1.0B, representing a significant discount to Dream Security's current valuation.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $850M (low) to $6.6B (high), with a median of $3.4B. The wide spread reflects material tension between stage-based progression methodology, which anchors to historical step-up patterns, and peer comparables, which suggest substantially lower current market pricing for same-stage Defense & Security assets. Key uncertainties include whether Dream Security commands a justifiable premium to peer medians based on differentiated technology, commercial traction, or founder reputation, and whether the stage-progression multiplier appropriately reflects current market conditions in the defense sector.
